task.instruction: Identify a new course or Specialization on Coursera related to Python Data Science, sort the courses by newest, what the first course is and which institution offers it.

final_answer:
With the search "python data science" sorted by Newest, the first result is "Project Management with AI For Dummies", offered by John Wiley & Sons. It is a Beginner course that takes 3–6 months and is tagged "New".

That result isn't really about Python or data science. The Newest sort returns about 10,000 results, and the newest ones are mostly unrelated. The next few are "Zero Trust Architecture and Security Strategy" (John Wiley & Sons), "Podcasting For Dummies" (John Wiley & Sons) and "Financial Modeling and Risk Valuation" (Perplexity). After those come several AWS Dev courses from Amazon Web Services.

If you want the newest Python-specific item, the "Best Match" list has two entries tagged "New". They are "Python for Business Data Science" (Madecraft, Specialization) and "The Complete Python and Data Science Bootcamp" (Packt, Specialization).

judge.rationale: Final page shows search for “python data science” sorted by Newest, with first result “Project Management with AI For Dummies” by John Wiley & Sons.
